summary: The figure shows the density of select health professionals per 10,000 population across six WHO regions from 2014 to 2021. The European Region has the highest density of medical doctors (36.6) and nursing and midwifery personnel (83.4), while the African Region has the lowest densities across all categories. Nursing and midwifery personnel have the highest densities overall compared to other health professionals in all regions.
